سَفَّاحٌ A shedder of much blood. (A.) [Hence,] السَّفَّاحُ is the name of A sword of Homeyd Ibn-Bahdal. (K.) ―
-b2- [Hence also,] (assumed tropical:) A giver of many gifts; or one who gives much. (K.) ―
-b3- And (assumed tropical:) Chaste [or rather fluent or eloquent] in speech; syn. فَصِيحٌ: (K:) or possessing ability for speech. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
